title: Daily digest: Vijaya Reddy Moves Telangana High Court  | Andhra Pradesh HC sets aside 34 per-cent | BJP intensifies protests across Keralam  | Productive discussion with USTR Greer on
headline: 📰 LATEST NEWS
source: Munsif Daily / Telangana Today / The Hindu
bullets_en: Vijaya Reddy Moves Telangana High Court Over Khairatabad By-Election Notification.
Andhra Pradesh HC sets aside 34 per-cent BC quota in local elections.
BJP intensifies protests across Keralam after attack on party’s State office.
Productive discussion with USTR Greer on early conclusion of trade deal: Goyal.
bullets_ur: Vijaya Reddy ne Khairatabad by-election ke notification ke khilaf Telangana High Court mein appeal ki.
Andhra Pradesh high court ne local elections mein 34 percent BC quota ko khatam kar diya.
BJP ne Keralam mein saraahkash ehtijaj shuroo kar diye jabke unki state office par hamla hua
Mazboot muzakirat USTR Greer ke sath tijaat ka muahida jaldi khatam karne par: Goyal.
